Hymn 100: Nearer, My God, to Thee
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Lowell Mason
Lyricist/Text Author: Sarah F. Adams
Category: Prayer and Supplication

This is hymn number 100 titled "Nearer, My God, to Thee" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Lowell Mason and the lyrics were written by Sarah F. Adams.
This hymn is categorized under: Prayer and Supplication.
